## Scope check

This project is deliberately small. Two things to note before proposing:

- It is a **client for dsh**, not a replacement. Changes to the agent itself belong upstream.
- It has **one runtime dependency by design**. A proposal that needs a new dependency is still
  welcome, but explain why the dependency is worth it.

Does your request fit those constraints? If not, say so — it is better to find out now.
